title: Next To Something: the Postposition mellett

sections.content: mellett means 'next to / beside'. Like other Hungarian postpositions, it comes after the noun it relates to, rather than before it like an English preposition.

items.spanish: A bank mellett van a posta.
items.english: The post office is next to the bank.

sections.content: Word order is the opposite of English here: say 'a bolt mellett' (the shop next-to), never 'mellett a bolt' -- the postposition always follows its noun.
